summary: River traffic memorandum indicates small craft passed the southern causeway in staggered intervals. Boatmen complained of missing fuel, conflicting orders, and patrol whistles heard farther upstream than expected. One clipped transmission referred to a convoy that never arrived in the daylight logs. No further clarification was attached to the fragment. Cross-reference marks suggest the page once belonged to a thicker bound ledger. One notation references a compartment or packet not visible in the current copy.
